constraints.constraint: All expense data persisted to IndexedDB via Dexie db.expenses table
All monetary calculations (totals, subtotals) use big.js for cent-level precision
Forms use React Hook Form with Zod resolver for validation
Components in src/components/accounts/, hooks in src/hooks/, validation in src/lib/validation/
ExpenseCategory must be one of: housing, transport, food, utilities, insurance, entertainment, other
ExpenseEntry stores amount as string for big.js compatibility
Follow established Form/Card/List/Section component pattern from Income story
Use Result type for all async operations in hooks
Toast notifications: success for save/update/delete, error for failures

tests.standards: Vitest is the test runner with React Testing Library for component tests. Use fake-indexeddb/auto for Dexie tests. Tests are located in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Each component/hook/validation module has corresponding test file. Follow AAA pattern (Arrange, Act, Assert). Use waitFor for async operations. Clear database state in beforeEach for isolation.
